outcomes.label: Safe to continue
outcomes.meaning: Everything fits and is within acceptable limits

outcomes.label: Needs more investigation
outcomes.meaning: We don't yet know enough to decide

outcomes.label: Needs treatment / optimisation
outcomes.meaning: A problem can be fixed (now in S2, or before a re-booked date in S1)

outcomes.label: Needs senior or anaesthetic review
outcomes.meaning: Decision is beyond the trainee or affects anaesthesia

outcomes.label: Emergency
outcomes.meaning: The patient may be in danger now

checks.text: Any emergency sign, or a life-threatening problem still open?
Is a result the case needs still unopened?
Does the diagnosis look different or complicated (a problem that changes the pathway)?
Is there a fixable problem still open (safety blocker, time-critical or optimisable)?
Is anything affecting the anaesthetic (a fasting breach, ASA 3 or more)?
Nothing left: safe to continue to consent and preparation
